@@ -1095,6 +1095,18 @@ def rc_context(rc=None, fname=None):
             rcParams.update(rc)
         yield
     finally:
+        if (dict.__getitem__(orig, "backend") is rcsetup._auto_backend_sentinel
+                and "backend" in rcParams
+                and dict.__getitem__(rcParams, "backend")
+                is not rcsetup._auto_backend_sentinel):
+            # Restoring *orig* would un-resolve the auto sentinel that may
+            # have been resolved while inside the ``with`` block (e.g., by
